title: Steel wire brads: length and wire diameter

citation.standard: Federal Specification FF-N-105B, Nails, Brads, Staples and Spikes: Wire, Cut and Wrought (17 March 1971)
citation.publisher: General Services Administration, United States of America — a U.S. Government federal specification, in the public domain
citation.where: §3.6.1, "Type I - Brads. Steel wire, brad head, diamond point, round smooth shank, bright finish.", page 8 (the page numbered 8 at its foot), whose table gives L (length, in), D (wire diameter, in) and No./lb, with S (the penny-size trade designation) beside some rows; "--" means none is given. Rows below are every row of that table. NOTE ON THE DOCUMENT'S STATUS: FF-N-105B was cancelled on 3 December 1996 (Notice 2) and ASTM F1667 is its successor; F1667's dimension tables are behind a paywall and were not read, so these rows are cited to the last readable primary source and a reviewer with F1667 should check them. Retrieved 2026-09-24 as a PDF from the url given (the fetch worked without a Referer that day), read as text.
